race.description: Real Punters Play Here Tabtouch Hcp (C1)
race.comment: MERIVALE LOUVAIN (7) showed a stack of talent in only 2 starts as a juvenile, winning on debut here, before rushing home for second as the favourite at Belmont in June. She resumes from a spell that would have done her the world of good, so expect her to be ready to rumble fresh up. FREE TO FLY (6) made progress last season, and will be a lot stronger this season. A wide gate won't help, but a 1.5kg is an advantage fresh up, so keep her safe in all combos. GALACTIC COMMUNITY (10) clung on by a nose to win on debut in the bush at Collie 10 days ago. This is much harder, and she also cops a wide gate, but she will only improve with racing, so stick with her to be safe. UNIVERSAL HOTNESS (8) resumes from a spell, and has found it hard to win another race. This assignment is well within his scope, and fresh up, he can make his presence felt. Include.
